target.name: ascend950pr
target.notes: Validated arch35 AIV limits: EVENT_ID0..3 and 256 KiB UB, of which at most 216 KiB is usable for tensors after the 8 KiB compiler reserve and 32 KiB SIMT DataCache floor. Pipeline timing remains uncalibrated, so performance advisories are withheld.

diagnostics.title: EVENT_ID not statically resolvable
diagnostics.message: WaitFlag<MTE3_MTE2>(slot) uses an event id the analyzer cannot resolve (slot); its pairing is unchecked
diagnostics.remediation: Use a literal EVENT_IDn, or unroll the ping/pong selection so each buffer slot has a fixed event id. A runtime-selected id defeats static pairing analysis.

diagnostics.title: Cross-pipeline hazard without synchronisation
diagnostics.message: 'keyLabelRing' is written by DataCopy on PIPE_MTE2 and read by DataCopy on PIPE_MTE3 with no SetFlag/WaitFlag pair or global barrier ordering them; the pipelines run concurrently, so the read races the write
diagnostics.remediation: Raise SetFlag<HardEvent::MTE2_MTE3>(EVENT_IDn) after the DataCopy and WaitFlag on the same channel before the DataCopy, or issue PipeBarrier(PIPE_ALL) between them.
